about: Questions proposed for the scholarship challenge (accounts.views.ScholarshipStartView draws 5; a student needs 5/5). Apply with: python manage.py apply_scholarship_pool --apply.
selection: UPSC CMS 2018-2025, active, text only (no figure, no table, no figure reference), four options, not free showcase, not disputed / controversial / dropped / needs review, no open answer-key audit signal, and a key that came with the paper import or the original bank (key_audit provenance import / unknown) -- never an AI-chosen key. Each key was then read against standard textbook knowledge in an AI-assisted review; ambiguous, outdated or garbled questions were left out.
caveat: Proposed by CrackLabs for the owner to confirm. Joining the pool does not verify a key: every question keeps its stored key, and review_note is a reviewer note, not a source. explanation_conflicts_with_key marks a question whose explanation in the bank names another answer than the key (the key is the standard answer; the explanation needs an edit).
